summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating the file renaming of papagayo-ng.py to papagayo-vue.py, updating contributor and redevelopment credits for Victory Ukpong (redevelopment in 2026) across about files, setting Dark Grey default with selectable Light/Slate presets and full custom color scheme, producing dual Windows executables (Papagayo-VUE.exe and Papagayo-VUE_debug.exe) via GitHub Actions, and delivering a beginner-friendly copy-paste crash diagnostic tool.
